```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT subitem (#PCDATA)>">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY ent "Standard Entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising comment and namespace features -->
  <item xmlns:foo="http://example.org/foo">
    <?foo-processing-instruction data="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup <item>&ent;</item> and entities.
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_macro "<!ENTITY nested 'Deeply nested entity value'>">
  %local_macro;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="test"?>
<root xmlns="urn:test:root" xmlns:sub="urn:test:sub">
  <!-- Multi-line comment 
       with various symbols <>&'" -->
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with <sub:child> markup.
    ]]>
    &nested;
  </sub:child>
  <child>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block.
    ]]>
  </child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; with extra text">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-tool name="validator" version="1.0"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/schema" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment: Inventory items follow -->
  <product xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org/prod1">
    <![CDATA[
      Product description with special characters <>&'" inside CDATA.
    ]]>
    &derived;
  </product>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Entity One">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Entity Two">
  <!ENTITY % param_ent "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">
  %param_ent;
]>
<?xml-server port="8080" protocol="http"?>
<database xmlns="http://db.org/ns" xmlns:db="http://db.org/ns/ext">
  <!-- Comment before a complex mixed content node -->
  <record>
    <?db-action query="select *"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload data containing <record>&ent2;</record> tags.
    ]]>
    &ent2;
  </record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (doc*)>
  <!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY core "Core Data">
  <!ENTITY ref "&core; Reference">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY notes SYSTEM "notes.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-meta author="TestAgent" date="2023-10-01"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/meta">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment block testing parser limits -->
  <doc meta:id="doc1">
    <?meta-command execute="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Complex CDATA with nested structures and &ref; expansions.
    ]]>
    &ref;
  </doc>
</archive>
